Based on the search results from the project's recorded history, I found the information:

Karl Sorensen started the discussion thread "[DISCUSS] KIP-1290: Rack-Aware Minimum In-Sync Replicas" on the dev@kafka.apache.org mailing list on 2026-02-25. This discussion led to the creation of the JIRA issue **KAFKA-20231** on 2026-02-26, which is titled "KIP-1290: Rack-Aware Minimum In-Sync Replicas".
